goal: Prevent wallets with corrupted transaction records from repeatedly rescanning the entire chain on load
Stop the wallet from operating on corrupted data with missing spend tracking and cache entries
Make restoring from a backup the clear recovery path for corrupted wallets
reviewability: Waiting on author to respond to an open objection regarding inverted hashes in an error message
agreement: Unaddressed objection: error message inverts stored and actual hashes, no author reply (jeanpablojp)
Strong support for failing fast on corruption rather than attempting unreliable rescans (pablomartin4btc, rkrux)
Verified by testing and reproducing corruption on regtest (jeanpablojp)
Addressed objection: concern that failing to load locks users without backups out of funds (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents corrupted records from triggering repeated rescans from genesis on every restart
Avoids silent state bugs by stopping the wallet from running with partially loaded, untracked transactions
